comparison.title: One changed preparation, the same external events
comparison.explanation: A battery keeps surplus energy for later. Alignment changes generation for only three production days. The alternate result has 5.7 less air, 12 less food and 6 more Parts than your original result.
reasons: The original plan had 3 days with power-limited machines; the alternate had 5.
Recorded food production: 24 units originally and 12 in the alternative.
comparison.caveat: Both outcomes use the same ending day. Later requested actions were held constant.
